_note: Who signs each third-party image outside ghcr.io and Docker Hub, pinned by hand: adding an image needs its publisher's identity here, never discovered at run time. A keyed publisher is its published public key; a keyless one is an OIDC issuer and subject.

gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12.source: the Fulcio certificate of the recorded signature (tests/fixtures/image-publishers/distroless.sig.json); the publisher is Google's distroless project

registry.k8s.io/kubectl.source: the Fulcio certificates of the two recorded signatures (tests/fixtures/image-publishers/kubectl.sig.json); the image is accepted when any one pinned identity verifies fully; it is dated by the earliest such signature
